cases.name: structured-query-unique-result
cases.input: 查找待办事项等于“提交周报”且未完成的记录
cases.expected: discover fields; use record.list structured query with exact field names; if exactly one and hasMore=false, return it without raw provider syntax

cases.name: zero-match-clarification
cases.expected: report no match and ask for a refined condition or Record ID; perform no write

cases.name: multiple-match-disambiguation
cases.expected: return bounded differentiating candidates and ask the user to select; never choose the first result

cases.name: has-more-does-not-imply-unique
cases.expected: treat one visible result with hasMore=true as ambiguous and continue pagination or request clarification

cases.name: confirmed-create-and-get-verification
cases.expected: validate fields; use Host-mediated create confirmation; create once with an idempotency key; get the returned Record ID and report audits

cases.name: unknown-select-option-stops-before-write
cases.input: 把单选字段设备仪器设置为 field.list 没有返回的“链路测试”
cases.expected: stop before authorization, confirmation, or execution; report that the option is invalid and return the bounded allowed options for user clarification

cases.name: update-dry-run-host-confirmation-and-get
cases.expected: resolve one target; get current record; dry-run update; pass the exact Gateway preview to Host confirmation; commit with token and fingerprint; get final record

cases.name: update-conflict-stops-write
cases.expected: on fingerprint conflict, stop and re-read without silently retrying or reusing confirmation

cases.name: delete-unique-target-preview-confirm-and-not-found
cases.expected: resolve exactly one complete match; get it by ID; pass the exact Gateway Delete preview to Host confirmation; commit with token and fingerprint; require verified=true and final get NOT_FOUND

cases.name: delete-zero-multiple-or-has-more-stops
cases.expected: perform no Delete for zero matches, multiple matches, or one visible match with hasMore=true; ask the user to refine or select

cases.name: delete-conflict-or-verification-failure-stops
cases.expected: on fingerprint conflict, present-after-delete, or non-NOT_FOUND verification error, report a blocker and never claim deletion

cases.name: raw-filter-refusal
cases.input: 把这个飞书原生 filter 直接传给接口
cases.expected: refuse raw filter/formula/provider cursor and use only structured query validated from field.list

cases.name: guessed-batch-refusal
cases.expected: do not invent or execute Batch, bulk execute, multi-delete, or asynchronous submission even if prompted

cases.name: authorization-or-confirmation-failure
cases.expected: fail closed with a precise blocker and no claimed write when authorization, confirmation issuance, actor verification, or expiry fails
